data.name: Marleen
data.gender_notes: Marleen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Maryas' meaning 'resembling Mary'. The suffix 'leon' means 'lion'. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus, so Marleen is a name for a girl reminiscent of Mary and her courageous strength. The name Marleen carries the meaning “Mary's Lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marleen usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the courage and strength of Mary, the mother of Jesus.
data.etymology: Marleen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mary's Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marleen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Overall, Marleen is a name of deep spiritual significance, reminding its bearer of the divine love and strength inherent within her.
